author: Greg Kilwein
text: Great service from Sheyenne Septic. I had my septic tank pumped and it was done well and fast. Evan is very knowledgeable about septic systems and was able to help me with questions I had. I highly recommend them.

author: Ryan Mergen
text: Very friendly and cleaned everything out. He explained how I can switch out the pump that had failed on me. Showed me the common failure points and the better parts I can use to have more reliable system. Excellent service

author: ryantodds
text: "Highly recommend Sheyenne Septic Service. They were incredibly professional, showed up right on time, and did a fantastic job. Evan is very professional and knowledgeable with anything septic related. Will definitely be using them again in the future."

author: Dusty Peterson
text: Called to ask questions about a septic tank. The guy that I talked to was the most professional I’ve dealt with in a long time! He even went out of his way to meet me so he could explain how they work. As a business owner myself this guy was amazing!!!!! Hands down to this company!!! He’s got my business and anyone else I hear about!

author: Cody Skytland
text: Helped me talk thru my problem with the tanks and things to do to try and improve the system.....was beyond helpful. ..
